description:
As a customer, I want to filter the products.

* Filters should narrow down the list correctly.

criteria.text: Filters should narrow down the list correctly.

cases.title: Applying a filter narrows the product list to matching products
cases.preconditions: Product list page is open and shows products, including <at least one product that matches the filter value to be used> and <at least one product that does not match that filter value>.
steps: Note the products currently shown in the list.
Apply the filter <a filter available on the product list> with the value <a filter value matched by at least one product>.
cases.expected: The list is narrowed to only the products matching the applied filter; the non-matching products noted in step 1 are no longer listed.

cases.title: A filter value with no matching products
cases.preconditions: Product list page is open and shows products; <a filter value that no product matches> is known.
steps: Apply the filter <a filter available on the product list> with the value <a filter value that no product matches>.
cases.expected: No products are listed, since no product matches the filter. Any message or empty-state shown is not specified in the story.

cases.title: Two filters applied together narrow the list further
cases.preconditions: Product list page is open and shows products; <two filters available on the product list> and values such that <at least one product matches both values> and <at least one product matches only the first value>.
steps: Apply the first filter with <a value matched by at least one product> and note the resulting list.
Without clearing the first filter, apply the second filter with <a value matched by only some of the products from step 1>.
cases.expected: The list is narrowed further to only the products matching both filter values; the products from step 1 that do not match the second value are no longer listed.
